concepts.why: The patient presents with a large, crusted, erythematous plaque on the right chest, which is consistent with psoriasis.
The patient's history of a painful area on the right lateral chest and the presence of a large, crusted, erythematous plaque are consistent with atopic dermatitis.
The patient's history of a painful area on the right lateral chest and the presence of a large, crusted, erythematous plaque are consistent with contact dermatitis.
The patient's presentation with a large, crusted, erythematous plaque on the right chest is consistent with seborrheic dermatitis.
The patient's history of taking prednisone and previous treatments with methotrexate and cyclosporine suggest a possible diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis.
The patient's history of taking prednisone and previous treatments with methotrexate and cyclosporine suggest a possible diagnosis of lupus erythematosus.
The patient's history of taking prednisone and previous treatments with methotrexate and cyclosporine suggest a possible diagnosis of sarcoidosis.
The patient's presentation with a large, crusted, erythematous plaque on the right chest is consistent with granuloma annulare.
